solutions.title: 2D DP table
solutions.strategy: Store the path count for every cell while zeroing blocked cells.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every grid cell is evaluated once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: A separate table stores one count per cell.

solutions.title: 1D rolling DP
solutions.strategy: Reuse a single row of path counts while scanning the grid left to right.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each cell updates one column count once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The rolling array stores one path count per column.
